services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: It all starts with a conversation. Our discovery call is your first step toward a healthier, stronger you. We listen to your short and long-term goals, identify obstacles in your way, and determine if we are the right fit for each other. This is where your journey begins. Next, we dive deeper with a comprehensive assessment. Our professional coaches work with you to get a clear picture of where you are right now. Utilizing movement screens, strength/balance tests and capacity assessments. Together, we set specific, achievable milestones and establish a realistic timeline.
